options.content: Caddy whitebox for the **reports-ui** static server + reverse proxy (RFC-0002). Caddy exposes native Prometheus metrics on its admin API by default; the Caddyfile's `metrics` handler re-exposes them on the `:8084` site listener so Prometheus can scrape them (RFC-0002 D6) -- the win over nginx that lets this second static frontend meet the full D6 contract (contrast: the React `frontend` has no `/metrics`, ADR-0013). All panels read the Prometheus datasource; `reports-ui` is an opt-in compose profile, so panels show *No data* when it is not up (expected, RFC-0001 D10). The reverse-proxy upstream is the reports service (`reports:8083`); its health line reads 0/absent when the `reports` profile is down (RFC-0002 D10 graceful degradation).

panels.title: Service Up
panels.description: up{job="reports-ui"} -- Prometheus scrape health (observability/prometheus.yml `reports-ui` job). 0/down when the `reports-ui` compose profile is not running (RFC-0001 D10 graceful degradation), 1 while it is scraped successfully.

panels.title: Requests In-flight
panels.description: caddy_http_requests_in_flight{job="reports-ui"} -- requests currently being handled by the site server. Near zero for a static server; brief bumps track proxied /api/* calls waiting on the reports backend.

panels.title: Upstream Healthy (reports)
panels.description: caddy_reverse_proxy_upstreams_healthy{job="reports-ui"} -- Caddy's active view of the reverse-proxy upstream (reports:8083). 1 healthy, 0 unhealthy; absent/No data when the `reports` profile is down -- the UI still serves its own assets (RFC-0002 D10), only proxied /api calls fail.

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate by Status
panels.description: sum(rate(caddy_http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="reports-ui"}[5m])) by (code) -- Caddy's request rate split by response status code. Mostly 200s (static assets, /healthz, /readyz, /metrics probes); a 5xx line is the signal a proxied /api/* call to reports is failing (e.g. reports profile down -> 503, the active health check having marked the upstream down).

panels.title: HTTP Request Latency p95
panels.description: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(caddy_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="reports-ui"}[5m])) by (le)) -- 95th-percentile round-trip request duration across all handlers. Static-asset requests are sub-millisecond; the tail is dominated by proxied /api/* calls whose latency is the reports backend's.

panels.title: Reverse-Proxy Upstream Health
panels.description: caddy_reverse_proxy_upstreams_healthy{job="reports-ui"} by upstream -- Caddy's health view of each reverse-proxy upstream over time (the reports service, reports:8083). Drops to 0 / goes absent when the `reports` profile is down; the UI keeps serving its static assets and D6 endpoints regardless (RFC-0002 D10).
